# `aitbc plugin list`

List all available brand plugins in the plugin directory.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc plugin list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--plugins-dir` | text | — | no | Directory containing .py brand plugins |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc plugin list
```
